from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class CategoryAssignment(BaseModel):
    """Captures the title of a single document and its assigned classification category."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The actual title of the judgment document as provided in the document")
    category: Literal['贪污受贿罪', '行政主体-劳动和社会保障行政管理（劳动，社会保障）', '执行案由-行政', '所有权纠纷', '行政行为-行政裁决'] | None = Field(description="The classification category assigned to this document from the 5 predefined types")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    classification_results: list[CategoryAssignment]
